title: Mapctl
description: mapctl.py - the anatomy tool: scan stubs cards, lint checks the map, compile builds the node/edge map, context audits guides and rules, architecture renders the code graph, anatomy reads the map, cards, layers, architecture.json and console.anatomy-template and renders the docs site's interactive anatomy page; its output docs/anatomy.html is a docs artifact, not a store. cap_boxes marks a fold whose members are all lazy as lazy.
